lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'm gonna develop a magical new product

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: that'll make every master in the world happy.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Ohmygodohmygod!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: The time has finally come.
What exactly is this new magical product?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I'm glad you asked.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: We're going to be introducing a new set meal that has fondue and black tea.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: However, any customer who orders that has to say a little jingle first.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Like say...

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Drip, drop. Splish, splash. Be delicious and don't be trash!

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Something like that.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Heh-heh.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I've got all sorts of great ideas stirring around.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Can I share a few choice ones?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: How about we all come up with our own little jingle?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Okay, mine will be:

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Squish, squelch, ketchup fondue for me and you!
Why the obsession with ketchup?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'm just giving them some options.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: My turn.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Bloop bloop, out comes the tea!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Isn't it cute? Now, repeat after me! Meow meow!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: For the last part, you gotta put your hands on your head like cat ears.
Isn't this embarrassing?
Sure, that should work.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Eh?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Do you really mean that? :(
No... of course not...

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Then prove it.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I can understand you might be a bit shy, but I know just how to overcome that.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: You just need to imagine yourself as a maid.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Then you can help us come up with some more slogans.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: We've got plenty of our own ideas.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Woohoo!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Master praised me.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Now I can die happy.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Oh no you don't. You don't get to die yet.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Now that we all shared our slogans,

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: it's your turn, Master.
I have to come up with one, too?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You don't have to,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: but since we're so ensconced in the maid industry,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: it could be helpful to hear some input from a layman.
Hmm...
I feel it might be best to say whatever first comes to mind.
No pain, no gain. You gotta grin and bear it, even if it's embarrassing!
Oooh-rah! Booyah! Gimme the cutest transformation of all, rah rah rah!

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: That...

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: was awesome!

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I can see some customers coming,

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: so we'll have to save the slogans for another time.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: A true maid must know when to stop.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'll go ahead and get back to cleaning!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Talk to you guys later.
Was my slogan really that bad?
... No one answers.
